title: Slide Through
style: Pop-rap with swaggering US slang, mid-tempo swung drums, bouncy sub bass, clipped handclaps, and bright synth stabs; verse rides sparse with tight vocal pockets, pre-chorus strips to bass and snapped percussion, chorus hits wider with stacked doubles and gang ad-libs. Add reverse swells into the hook, a quick tape-stop before the bridge, and delay throws on key punch lines. Crisp, punchy, radio-bright mix with a glossy low end.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pull up, baby, what’s good?
I been low-key, still top shelf
Same old fit, still lookin’ fresh
Got my name on the back of my breath

You talk slick, I talk cash
I don’t chase, I just pass
Got that grin like “bet, okay”
Whole room turn when I say

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up
You know the vibe
Too clean
Too alive

I don’t stress
I just glide
You want heat?
Step inside

[Chorus]
Slide through, slide through
That’s what I do
Slide through, slide through
And I come out smooth

Bet on me
I’m the one
Say less now
We already won

[Verse 2]
Phone on do not disturb
Still I pop out, make it heard
They all watch when I walk in
Big talk, I don’t fold in

Got that “say it with your chest” tone
New kicks, dirty on the edge, though
If it’s up, then it’s up tonight
If it’s cool, then we good, alright

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold up
You know the vibe
Too clean
Too alive

I don’t stress
I just glide
You want heat?
Step inside

[Chorus]
Slide through, slide through
That’s what I do
Slide through, slide through
And I come out smooth

Bet on me
I’m the one
Say less now
We already won

[Bridge]
Ayy, keep it a buck with me
You know I don’t front for free
No cap, I been on my way
Whole mood changed when I came

[Chorus]
Slide through, slide through
That’s what I do
Slide through, slide through
And I come out smooth

Bet on me
I’m the one
Say less now
We already won
